caption_L1: Here a is a line diagram called U.S. sweet potato production value from 2000 to 2019 (in 1,000 U.S. dollars). The y-axis plots Production value in thousand U.S. dollars using a linear scale from 0 to 800,000. There is a linear scale of range 2000 to 2015 along the x-axis, labeled Year.
caption_L2L3: Sweet potato production value has increased from 2000 to 2014 but not in a continuous way. There have been periods of declining value between 2000 and 2005, 2011 and 2012 and then again in 2014. The highest value was in 2014.
